items.text: Group rooms into your own folders. Right-click a room and choose Move to folder; folders sync across your devices.
Group rooms into your own folders. Long-press a room and choose Move to folder; folders sync across your devices.
The room you are in is no longer bold. Bold now means unread, nothing else.
Shortcuts such as Cmd/Ctrl+K work from the moment the window appears.
Reading a room offline no longer makes the timeline jump as connection banners come and go.
